biotools.summary: GPF-SFARI is an open-source platform that manages genotypes and phenotypes derived from family collections, facilitating interactive exploration of genetic variants and secure data sharing. It is utilized at the Simons Foundation to analyze data from cohorts like SSC and SPARK, providing access to de novo mutation collections and gene-level statistics.
